lines.en: I slide across the ice on my feet.
One wingbeat and frost falls off.
My soles make no sound at all.
I fly three and a half laps around you.
Ice blooms into flowers under my feet.
I walk with wind, and the wind brings snow.
The dew on the lotus leaf has frozen.

lines.zh: 薄冰在我脚下咔一声裂开。
lines.en: Thin ice snaps apart under my heel.
I fly lower, skimming the mist.

lines.zh: 这条路我自己冻出来的。
lines.en: I froze this path myself.
I count the ice chunks as I go.
Even my shadow trails white vapor.

lines.zh: 我把一颗薄荷糖含在嘴里。
lines.en: I keep a mint candy under my tongue.
My frozen frogs are lined up in a row.
I write my name in the ice with a finger.
Whoever called me stupid, I remember.
I count the six corners of an ice crystal.
Frost has settled in my hair.
I shape a tiny person out of ice.
This lake surface answers to me.

lines.zh: 我又把夏天的花冻住了。
lines.en: I froze another summer flower solid.
The colder it gets, the better I feel.
I kick at the block of ice below me.
One candy has melted halfway.
I am waiting for the snow to start.
An ice crystal spins in my palm.

lines.zh: 我数冰块上的裂纹，越数越多。
lines.en: I count cracks in the ice. The number grows.

lines.zh: 我把手插进雪里，凉得很舒服。
lines.en: I push my hands into the snow. Comfortably cold.
So you are back again, human.
I am no ordinary fairy, you know.
Are you afraid of cold? I am not.
The tip of your nose has gone red.
I fly a little higher to look at you.
Is that ice you are holding?
What are you laughing at? I am strong.
Frost is already whitening your lashes.
I am counting how many layers you wear.
Do you dare to fight the strongest?

lines.zh: 你站的地方开始结冰了。
lines.en: The ground where you stand is freezing.

lines.zh: 我看得见你呼出的白气。
lines.en: I can see every white breath you take.
Do not blink; I will do a trick.
Would you like one of my mint candies?
You really did land a hit on me.

lines.zh: 这一下打得我眼冒白星。
lines.en: It stings badly, yet I will not cry.
A bump is rising on my head.
That is not fair; you struck from behind.

lines.zh: 左边那片翅膀被撞折了。
lines.en: The wing on my left side is folded wrong.
That blow goes into my memory.
The ice cracked, and so did I.
I am stepping back, not running.
Wait until I freeze you for that.
It does not hurt at all. Liar.
Candy? Let me see it.
I am only interested in cold things.
You have lifted an ice block up.
That thing would freeze your hands.
I do not eat warm food, never.
Give me one pale blue candy.
I heard the bag rustle in your hand.
Come closer and let me sniff it.
I can trade you ice for that.

lines.zh: 手别缩回去，我还没瞧够。
lines.en: Keep your hand out; I am not done looking.
Hey, watch the wings!
You scattered my ice crystals.
A layer of frost has formed on my dress.
Back off, you are far too warm.
The bump made me slide half a step.
Do you want to be frozen too?
Do not touch; I am fragile.
That collision scattered all the mist.
I lift off to get out of your way.
My mint candy dropped on the ground.
I do not need anything like that.
An ice fairy is strong all by herself.
Why are you even asking me that?
I prefer my frozen frogs.
Who wants to freeze a lake with me?
Am I blushing? That is just frost.
Stop giggling; I mean every word.
My own ice is cold enough for me.
Let us put that topic aside.
I only make friends with the strong.
I pick up a piece of ice.
This candy fell on the ground.
I tuck the ice crystal into my sleeve.
My frozen frogs are my treasures.
I carry a huge block of ice along.
Anything I touch turns cold.

lines.zh: 这块冰我要了，别跟我抢。
lines.en: This ice is claimed; do not take it.
I pick it up and freeze it hard again.
I keep everything that falls down here.
Do not grab it; it is mine.
You cracked that thin layer of ice.
Someone touched my frozen frogs.
I have my eyes on you, human.
Those hands took one of my candies.
You left cracks across my ice.

lines.zh: 我数到三，你就跑不掉了。
lines.en: I count to three, and then you are stuck.
Someone is washing their face in my lake.
I froze this whole stretch of ice.
He laughed far too loudly just now.
I will cool him down properly.

lines.zh: 我的冰晶被他踩进泥里。
lines.en: He ground my ice crystal into the mud.
I lift off and swing around his side.
Hold still, do not run.
My ice arrow is already nocked.
You dared to call me stupid.
Three, then two, then one.
Frost is creeping under your feet.
I am not someone you can bully.
This round is already mine.
My danmaku can bend in midair.
Backing away will not help you.
I have already counted your steps.
All the water in the air obeys me.
I will land one clean hit.

lines.zh: 冰在地上爬过去找你了。
lines.en: The ice is crawling across the ground to you.
An ice spike bursts up beside your feet.
I close in and swat you once.
Is that cold enough for you?
Frost is spreading up your arm.
I slash past you with a blade of ice.

lines.zh: 我喊过一次了，是你没听。
lines.en: I did shout once; you simply did not listen.
I hit you. I actually hit you.
Three seconds frozen is plenty.
I spin around and fling out ice.
You shrink back two steps. Perfect.
The mist clears, and I arrive.
A sharp crack rings across the lake.
I step out of the cold air.
Who lit a fire around here?
An ice crystal lands before I do.
I have frozen this stretch of water.
Cold air sinks; I rise above it.
I slept through an entire winter.
Someone's breathing is far too warm.
The ice fairy has arrived.
I shake the frost off my shoulders.
This air is pleasantly cold.
I will sing first, then say hello.

lines.zh: 我踩住第一块结冰的草。
lines.en: I stand on the first frozen blade of grass.
Heat! Get that flame away from me.
I landed in the snow, luckily soft.
Water! I hate water more than anything.

lines.zh: 气浪把我的冰全吹散了。
lines.en: The blast blew all my ice apart.
An arrow grazed the edge of my wing.
What kind of magic is this? I hate it.
My candies are gone and so is my strength.
Lightning? Even I cannot fight that.
All black below me, and not a scrap of ice.
